title: Built from the inside, not the outside looking in.
intro: LabGenie is the product Datadivr built after years of F&B consulting, the same team, now shipping software instead of slide decks.
yearsText: some of the largest spice, flavor, and oleoresin manufacturers in the world.
leadIn: LabGenie was built out of Datadivr, a consulting firm that spent years working inside some of the biggest names in spices, flavors, and oleoresins. So it already knows:
knows: what a real quality spec looks like, in whatever format a customer sends it
how ingredient procurement actually works when input prices move every day
why the same product drifts batch to batch, and why that matters at release
closing: A generic AI tool has none of this. LabGenie has years of domain knowledge, embedded in every agent.
